descriptors.name: cdm.base.staticdata.party.EntityIdentifier
descriptors.label: Entity Identifier
descriptors.description: One identifier of a legal entity and the source that issued it, as CDM EntityIdentifier defines it. Stored inline in its legal entity's row.

identifier.name: identifier
identifier.label: Identifier
identifier.description: The identifier value, e.g. the 20-character LEI.

identifierType.name: identifierType
identifierType.label: Identifier Type
identifierType.description: The source of the identifier: BIC, LEI, MIC, REDID, COUNTRY_CODE or OTHER (CDM EntityIdentifierTypeEnum values).
